raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
These fixes come from the user's review of the GPU 2-CTA explainer video.

- **The comma between two numbers was read as a thousands separator.** Edge returned `间距是 2，257` as a single word and read it as 两千二百五十七 in 3 of 3 takes. `pronunciation.json` gets a new pattern that adds a space after a full-width `，` or `、` between digits (`2， 257`). The WordBoundary output then has `2` and `257` as separate words with a 0.35 s pause, and the captions still show `2，257`. Older projects had the same merge, for example `4 乘 128，512`.
- **调 on its own meaning "tune" is read diào.** `可以调 block 大小` came out wrong in 6 of 6 takes (poly_probe). With `调整` it was wrong in 0 of 6. `pronunciation.md` rule 11 now says to write a compound (调整 / 调优 / 调参). 调用 and 调度 already read correctly.
- **`house-style.md`:** warmup stays in English, never 暖机, and 暖机 is added to the list of Chinese renderings to grep for before TTS.
- **Tests:** `tests/test_explainer_pronounce.py` covers the digit-comma pattern. The `5、1、-1` expectation was updated for the extra space. All 13 tests pass.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

+  2026-10-22). Everyday words stay Chinese: 吞吐, 耗时, 并发, 端到端.
   Grep the narration **and the on-screen Scene strings** for Chinese renderings before TTS — 预填 (→ prefill),
-  前缀 (→ prefix), 每批 / 批次 (→ batch), 内核, 混批 — the user flagged 预填 on a title (DeepSeek V4.1 video, 2026-10-18).
+  前缀 (→ prefix), 每批 / 批次 (→ batch), 暖机 (→ warmup), 内核, 混批 — the user flagged 预填 on a title (DeepSeek V4.1
+  video, 2026-10-18).
 - Write numbers as digits (15%, 3.79 ms); the TTS reads them correctly and captions show them verbatim.
 - **Completeness over brevity.** No time limit: the film is as long as it takes to explain every algorithm

@@ -48,6 +48,12 @@ voice changes.
 9. **No space between two Han characters.** The voice pauses about 0.3 s there; `pronounce.py` drops such spaces
    in the spoken text. Spaces between Han and Latin (`这期 SGLang PR 讲解`) are fine and keep captions readable.
    `pron_check.py --meta` reports any pause > 0.2 s that is not at punctuation.
+10. **A comma between two numbers is read as a thousands separator.** In `间距是 2，257 会舍入成 256`, Edge returned
+    `2，257` as one word and read it as 两千二百五十七 (3/3 takes; 2-CTA video, flagged by the user). A pattern now
+    adds a space after a full-width `，` or `、` between digits (`2， 257`), which splits it into 2 / 257 with a
+    0.35 s pause. Captions still show `2，257`. Older projects had the same merge (`4 乘 128，512`, `12、12、8个`).
+11. **调 meaning "tune" is read diào when it stands alone.** `可以调 block 大小` came out as diào in 6/6 takes
+    (poly_probe). Write a compound, such as 调整 (0/6 wrong), 调优 or 调参. 调用 and 调度 are diào and need nothing.
